item.title: A fire at a popular nightclub in India's Goa state kills at least 25, officials say
item.description: NEW DELHI (AP) — At least 25 people, including tourists, were killed in a fire at a popular nightclub in India’s Goa state, the state’s chief minister said Sunday. The blaze occurred just past midnight in Arpora in North Goa, a party hub.
